thought.text: App and boards are 200 through the proxy, backend is up, Keycloak login works. Two issues to fix: cms returns 502 through the proxy (though it was 200 directly), and the actuator probe came back empty. Let me debug:

reasoning_content:
There are several issues to fix:
1. cms is returning 502 through the proxy (though cms direct was 200). Let me check.
2. The backend actuator returned empty.

Let me investigate. The actuator call returned empty — probably the /health path is wrong. The health check in compose uses port 8081 with a raw socket. Let me verify. Also, cms is 502 via the proxy but direct is 200 — probably a port mismatch between nginx.conf and where cms is actually listening. Let me check.

No wait — cms direct on 39002 returned 200 earlier. But via the proxy it's 502. And nginx.conf points to 39002. Let me re-verify the direct port and the nginx upstream.

Let me debug carefully.

action.command:
echo "=== cms direct (39002) ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 5 -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:39002/ 2>/dev/null || echo closed
echo "=== nginx upstream ports ==="; grep -oE "172\.[0-9.]+:[0-9]+" /workspace/.urbo/workspace/nginx.conf | sort -u
echo "=== is 39002 actually serving / with body? ==="; curl -s --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:39002/ 2>/dev/null | head -c 120; echo
echo "=== proxy error log for cms ==="; docker logs urbo-proxy --tail 8 2>&1 | grep -iE "cms|39002|error|upstream" | tail -6
